tips.text: Rank Aklato to 30 before selling it; selling early means buying it again.
Rank it on a high-level enemy farm such as Elite Sanctuary Onslaught, Hydron on Sedna or Helene on Saturn.
Rank it in public missions; squadmate kills share affinity and speed it up.
Unequip your maxed primary and melee while ranking it so more affinity lands on the Aklato.
